name: Calendar
accessibility: Each day cell is independently focusable and announces its full date, not just the day number.
Fully keyboard-navigable - arrow keys move between days, Page Up/Down move between months.

source.notes: State and Appearance (Full/Compact) are captured as crossed properties (State, Appearance) - every combination draws as its own Figma variant. Month label is a bound Text property. First day of week is an editable property not bound to any layer, since it reshapes which date lands in which grid cell and the weekday header labels - a structural recompute Figma can't perform from a bare property - the grid keeps whichever arrangement was active at capture time. Native property IDs retain canonical values; anatomy styles and tokens use context.unit.
